# The package directories under server/ that declare no layer, frozen by name (docs/server/architecture.md "Domain
# model", "Layers"): server/internal/archguard's TestDomainLayers fails on any other package whose package comment has
# no //persona:layer line. Undeclared packages count as application. These packages predate the rules; do not copy
# their shapes. A package that gains its line prints a notice, and its line here can go; add none: with a base, the
# test fails on a name the merge base's list lacks, unless a frozen package's files moved there (python3
